problem.title: 3 critical cash flow challenges businesses face
problem.p1Desc: Over 45% of B2B invoices are paid 10-30 days late, locking up vital working capital.
problem.p2Desc: Without predictability on payment timings, businesses risk missing payroll or supplier deadlines.
problem.p3Desc: Founders and accountants spend hours manually chasing debtors, risking client relationships.

howItWorks.title: How CashBridge works
howItWorks.subtitle: 3 simple steps to healthy B2B receivables
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select client by tax ID or name, enter line items, and generate a professional invoice.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Automated, polite reminders are dispatched via Telegram and Email before, on, and after the due date.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Client reliability scoring (0-100) helps you predict actual cash inflows for the next 30 days.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Reminders are sent through official Telegram bots and transactional emails according to your schedule rules.
faq.q2: How is the client reliability score calculated?
faq.a2: It ranges from 0 to 100 based on average payment delays, on-time payments, and currently overdue balances.
faq.q3: Can other companies access our invoice data?
faq.a3: Never. Database Row Level Security (RLS) ensures complete cryptographic and multi-tenant isolation.
